decision.subject: Zero-based MPV2 sequencing for Kubernetes Go-to-Rust port W0-A through W0-H
decision.dispatch_state_at_ratification: No masterplan execution wave is recorded as dispatched; the separate pre-planning authority hold remains open.
decision.scope_limit: This record authorizes W0-A through W0-H only. It does not authorize W1 or later corpus expansion.

ratification_authority.basis: Founder approval of the consensus Kubernetes Go-to-Rust rewrite plan through the structured ralplan execution gate on 2026-08-05, durably expressed by ADR-0637 and ADR-0638.
ratification_authority.scope_limit: This ratification binds only to the exact sequencing content identified by ratified_sequencing_digest. Mutation of a dependency endpoint pair, work-item order, or execution-wave membership requires fresh re-derivation and fresh founder ratification before dispatch. Relationship labels remain outside the digest.

digest_recipe: sha256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators ',' ':') of {"dependency_edges": sorted [from, to] pairs from masterplan_v2.dependency_edges, "execution_waves": the work_item_ids arrays of masterplan_v2.sequencing.execution_waves in wave order, "work_item_order": the work_item_id strings of masterplan_v2.sequencing.work_item_order in index order}

derivation.wave_rule: wave(n) = 0 when n has no prerequisite edges; otherwise 1 + max(wave(prerequisite)). Within a wave, work-item ids sort lexicographically; work_item_order is the wave-major concatenation with contiguous zero-based indices.

accepted_adr_contradiction_review.rationale: The new chain encodes only the approved W0 phase order. It preserves the k8s capability rung above os, keeps the single oya-ci-required merge authority, leaves ADR-0634 class-G automatic admission unavailable pending its own acceptance conditions, and does not dispatch any existing masterplan wave.

verification.fail_closed_contract: Absent, malformed, or mismatched ratification data emits masterplan_execution_wave_dispatch_unratified. The pre-planning authority hold remains an independent blocker.
